approved: Charter of Budget Honesty Amendment (Rural and Regional Australia Statements) Bill 2021

The Charter of Budget Honesty Amendment (Rural and Regional Australia Statements) Bill 2021 would require the Treasurer to publicly release a regional statement with each budget and economic outlook, assessing the impact of government decisions on regional Australia. The speaker noted that regional Australia contributes approximately 40% of national economic output and employs one-third of the workforce, and highlighted challenges in health and education access.
